content.title: Projects
content.description: Here is a curated showcase of my full-stack web applications, cloud platforms, and award-winning projects.

projects.heading: FarmConnect
projects.description: A comprehensive agricultural platform that streamlines livestock health tracking, automated inventory management, and real-time resource coordination across farming communities.
highlightsList: Problem: Disconnected livestock health tracking and manual inventory audits across regional farm operations.
Solution: Architected modular .NET Core RESTful endpoints with Entity Framework Core and normalized SQL Server schema for audit logging.
Outcome: Instant livestock record retrieval, scheduled medical alerts, and SSR-optimized dashboard rendering in Next.js 15.

projects.heading: DLouck
projects.description: A modern cloud asset management platform powered by Cloudflare R2 storage. Features a secure admin control panel with lightning-fast uploads, instant global search, and dynamic folder hierarchies with dark/light theme support.
highlightsList: Problem: High cloud egress bandwidth fees and sluggish multi-file synchronization with conventional cloud buckets.
Solution: Integrated Cloudflare R2 object storage with signed edge URLs for direct, low-latency browser uploads.
Outcome: Granular asset tagging, instant client search, zero egress costs, and sub-second asset delivery.

projects.heading: Visits Counter
projects.description: A real-time web traffic tracking service that dynamically compiles parameterized SVG visit badges for seamless integration into GitHub READMEs and personal websites.
highlightsList: Problem: Need for a frictionless, zero-setup visit tracking badge for developers' GitHub repositories and personal websites.
Solution: Engineered high-concurrency Node.js/Express API that calculates hits and dynamically compiles parameterized SVG graphics.
Outcome: Serves live hit counters with low-latency edge caching across hundreds of open-source profile views.

projects.heading: Ramaa Creations
projects.description: Built during the Alibaba Cloud Low-Code Development Contest 2022 using AliCMS and Alibaba Cloud infrastructure. Achieved global 2nd position out of 2,043 participating developers worldwide.
highlightsList: Problem: Rapid deployment of a performant, omnichannel luxury jewellery e-commerce storefront under strict hackathon deadlines.
Solution: Utilized AliCMS structured schemas, Alibaba Cloud CDN edge caching, and serverless compute pipelines.
Outcome: Global 2nd Place Winner out of 2,043 developers internationally, evaluated on architecture, UX, and performance.

projects.heading: StackOverflow Clone
projects.subHeading: Q&A Community Forum with AI Chatbot
projects.description: A full-featured developer question-and-answer platform built on the MERN stack. Includes JWT user authentication, real-time reputation and voting systems, keyword-based search, and an integrated Kommunicate live chatbot.
highlightsList: Engineered developer Q&A forum with JWT auth, vote tallying, keyword search, and integrated live chatbot.

projects.heading: Amazon Clone
projects.description: A full-featured e-commerce web application featuring Firebase user authentication, dynamic shopping cart management, detailed product checkout workflows, and integrated Stripe payment processing.
highlightsList: Built full e-commerce checkout flow with Firebase user authentication, dynamic cart state, and Stripe payment processing.

projects.heading: MyChat
projects.description: A responsive Android chat application allowing users to communicate seamlessly via real-time messaging on mobile devices. Features Firebase database backend, intuitive UI design, and instant message synchronization.
highlightsList: Developed native Android instant messenger with real-time websocket synchronization and push notifications.
